title: Configuration profiles pending on a large share of devices

maxPendingPct.text: Share still pending before delivery is treated as stalled

settledDays.text: Days after a change before pending stops being normal

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile has', 'profiles have')} not reached more than {params.maxPendingPct}% of their devices

messages.businessImpact: The policy is neither applied nor failed, it simply has not arrived, usually because the devices are not checking in.
remediation: Cross-check against devices that have not contacted the service recently, which is usually the same population.
Where the devices are healthy, look for a network path or proxy blocking the service endpoints.
